mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 41 degrees with clear skies at Verona Community Park. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona is inviting residents to a public meeting on December 8 at the Senior Center to discuss the Military Ridge State Trail paving project, including bridge replacements and trail closures. Additionally, please remember to keep your recycling carts clear of obstructions and placed out by 7 AM.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's today. Tomorrow, you can catch live music at Paddy Mac's or enjoy pizza and a pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a report covering November 1 through 15, police noted an incident on November 8 where a driver was arrested for O W I after striking a light pole.
You can grab the tasty Caramel Turtle flavor at Culver's, which opens today at 10 AM.
